name: node-rollup
description: Minimal Node.js + Rollup app instrumented with PostHog error tracking and source map upload. `start` binds the uploaded symbol sets to a release the usual way; `start:releaseless` flips the plugin onto debug ids + --no-release-bind. The plugin and posthog-cli are local builds, since neither path has shipped.

scripts.start: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm run:app
scripts.start:releaseless: pnpm clean && pnpm build:releaseless && pnpm run:app
